label: Launch & landing
compute: // Paragliding sites by terrain alone. Landing (1): flat enough over 100 m.
// Launch (2): 20-35° slopes facing into the wind, with the ground falling away
float landing = (1.0 - smoothstep(4.0, 7.0, s)) * (1.0 - smoothstep(4.0, 7.0, slopeDeg(100.0)));

presentation.footnote: 1 landing (green) · 2 launch (orange). No obstacles, wind or airspace data.
